+import pefile, capstone, pathlib, sys
+
+for p in pathlib.Path('artifacts/hard_repair').glob('*.exe'):
+    pe = pefile.PE(str(p))
+    print('\n',p.name,'base',hex(pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase),'entry',hex(pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.AddressOfEntryPoint))
+    data=p.read_bytes()
+    for s in pe.sections:
+        print(s.Name.decode().strip('\0'),hex(s.VirtualAddress),hex(s.Misc_VirtualSize),hex(s.PointerToRawData))
+    for needle in (b'ACCEPT',b'REJECT'):
+        pos=data.find(needle)
+        print(needle, 'offset',hex(pos), 'rva',hex(pe.get_rva_from_offset(pos)) if pos>=0 else '')
+    s=next(s for s in pe.sections if s.Name.startswith(b'.text'))
+    md=capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86,capstone.CS_MODE_64)
+    md.detail=True
+    insns=list(md.disasm(s.get_data(),pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase+s.VirtualAddress))
+    strings={pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase+pe.get_rva_from_offset(data.find(n)):n for n in (b'ACCEPT',b'REJECT')}
+    for i,ins in enumerate(insns):
+        refs=[]
+        for op in ins.operands:
+            if op.type==capstone.x86.X86_OP_MEM and op.mem.base==capstone.x86.X86_REG_RIP:
+                target=ins.address+ins.size+op.mem.disp
+                if target in strings: refs.append(strings[target])
+        if refs:
+            print('string ref',hex(ins.address-pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase),ins.mnemonic,ins.op_str,refs)
+        if ins.mnemonic=='cmp' and ('0x20' in ins.op_str or '0x100' in ins.op_str or '0x21' in ins.op_str):
+            print('cmp',hex(ins.address-pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase),ins.mnemonic,ins.op_str,' '.join('%02X'%x for x in ins.bytes))

+import pefile,pathlib,subprocess
+
+samples=[(0,0,'REJECT'),(0,0x20,'ACCEPT'),(0,0x21,'REJECT'),(1,0x20,'REJECT'),(1,0x21,'ACCEPT'),(0xff,0x21,'ACCEPT'),(0x100,0x20,'ACCEPT'),(0x100,0x21,'REJECT'),(0x101,0x21,'REJECT'),(0x80,0x20,'ACCEPT'),(0x80,0,'REJECT')]
+locs={'repair_v1.exe':(0x1177,0x117c),'repair_v2.exe':(0x1207,0x120c),'repair_v3.exe':(0x1187,0x118c)}
+for p in pathlib.Path('artifacts/hard_repair').glob('*.exe'):
+ pe=pefile.PE(str(p)); b=bytearray(p.read_bytes()); a,c=locs[p.name]
+ assert b[pe.get_offset_from_rva(a)]==0x73
+ assert b[pe.get_offset_from_rva(c)]==0x75
+ b[pe.get_offset_from_rva(a)]=0x77
+ b[pe.get_offset_from_rva(c)]=0x74
+ out=pathlib.Path('repaired_'+p.name); out.write_bytes(b)
+ errors=[]
+ for x,y,want in samples:
+  got=subprocess.run([str(out.resolve()),hex(x),hex(y)],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
+  if got!=want: errors.append((hex(x),hex(y),want,got))
+ print(p.name,'PASS' if not errors else errors)
